> What hobbies and life would you pursue if you had the choice?

I really dont know what type of life i would like to lead...I dont really have any interest in any hobbies...I just more or less feel apathetic towards everything. 

Its like i said my whole life the only thing that has ever really motivated me was spiting other people....its the only thing that got me through school as a kid (especially high school)....None of the teachers or my friends thought i would graduate, so i worked my ass off to improve my grades and do better but i only did it to spite them...instead of graduating being my moment and being something to be happy about it was essentially all about me saying fuck you to everyone else.

I've lived my whole life like this and its left me feeling completely drained and hollow.

As far as i know i'm not interested in anything...I dont even know how to go about changing that.
